accountRecovery.title: Account operation needs confirmation
accountRecovery.meaning: The network or response did not confirm the outcome. The original operation identity is retained and new account metadata writes are paused. Query the formal result first.
accountRecovery.notRecorded: No successful receipt is recorded yet. The original request may still be processing or may have rolled back; this does not establish failure. Recovery keeps the same identity and input, with successful operations applied once by the server.
accountRecovery.recoverMeaning: Keep the original operation ID and input. Return its original receipt if it succeeded; otherwise execute the original operation. Current account state is reloaded after confirmation.
accountRecovery.confirmed: Formal receipt confirmed; current account reloaded
accountRecovery.unreadable: The pending operation record cannot be read. Account metadata writes are paused. Preserve the browser record for diagnosis; do not create another operation identity.

credentialManager.scope: Credential material is encrypted on the server. Structural validation checks its format. Exchange permissions and connectivity require their own formal verification.
credentialManager.effect_CREATE: Create a new encrypted version. If a version of this type is in use, select it for rotation.
credentialManager.effect_ROTATE: Replace the selected active version and retain it as rotated. Provide a reason and confirm the new material.
credentialManager.effect_VERIFY: Validate the structure of this selected active version locally. This does not establish exchange permissions or trading authority.
credentialManager.effect_DISABLE: Stop NQ from using this version and retain its history. Re-enabling requires a separate command and structural validation.
credentialManager.effect_ENABLE: Structurally validate this disabled version. Re-enabling is rejected if another active version of this type exists.
credentialManager.effect_EXPIRE: Mark this version as expired in NQ and stop using it. Keep its history.
credentialManager.effect_REVOKE: Permanently revoke this version in NQ. It cannot be re-enabled. You still need to delete the key at the exchange separately.
credentialManager.reasonHint: Do not include keys, passphrases or other sensitive material
credentialManager.unknownMeaning: The original request may have committed. Query its result before any duplicate operation. Only operation identity is retained; keys and reasons are not saved.
credentialManager.notRecorded: No successful receipt is currently recorded. This does not prove the request failed or stopped. Re-enter the original material and reason to resume under the same identity.
credentialManager.originalTargetMeaning: Confirm the original account, type and version. Recovery retains the same identity and does not require credential material.
credentialManager.notRecordedTarget: No successful receipt is recorded yet. This does not prove the request failed or stopped. Confirm the original account and version to resume structural validation under the same identity.
credentialManager.originalInputMeaning: Use the same material and reason as the original request. Recovery retains its identity. Different input is rejected when a successful receipt already exists.
credentialManager.unreadable: Local operation identity cannot be read. Credential writes are paused. Keep this browser session and check its storage.
credentialManager.otherPending: Account #{{account}} has a pending credential operation. Return to that account to query its result.
credentialManager.pendingAccount: The original operation for account #{{account}} still needs confirmation.

accountFees.binanceTestnetUnavailable: Binance Spot Test Network lacks the required permission endpoint. Fees cannot be synchronized for this SIM account; mainnet fees will not be substituted.
accountFees.commissionFormula: Add the maker or taker component to the buyer or seller component, then total standard, tax and special fees. Positive native values are costs; negative values are rebates.
accountFees.discountBoundary: Only standard commission is discounted. Tax and special fees are unchanged. Enabled flags do not prove sufficient discount asset balance or actual discounted payment.
accountFees.directionalConsumptionPending: Complete conditions are retained. The current scalar run model does not yet support these direction and payment conditions, so this source cannot be used in backtests or SIM runs yet. Implementation remains pending.
accountFees.title: Account fees
accountFees.scope: These observations record the account’s spot rates at synchronization time. They do not establish historical rates or fees already charged on fills.
accountFees.chooseSymbol: Choose a pair from the formal catalog
accountFees.syncMeaning: Read current {{symbol}} rates for account “{{account}}” with credential version #{{credential}}. This reads account configuration and fees and stores an observation. It places no orders and grants no trading permissions.
accountFees.noCredential: No active credential version of the selected type is available for synchronization. Existing observations remain readable.
accountFees.sourceDisabled: A controlled private fee source is not enabled for this account or pair. Defaults and research assumptions cannot stand in for actual rates. Existing observations remain available.
accountFees.unsupportedVenue: Actual account fee sourcing for this venue still needs implementation. This entry preserves the capability gap and shows no invented rates.
accountFees.noHistory: No fee observations for this account and pair yet
accountFees.readFailed: Records could not be read; history cannot be assumed empty
accountFees.signMeaning: NQ cost rates use positive values for charges and negative values for rebates; zero remains zero. OKX uses the opposite convention, with original values retained in source details. The five-minute validity window describes this observation and does not prove historical rates. Actual fill fees remain defined by formal trades and ledger facts.
accountFees.unknownMeaning: Keep the original identity and target. Query its result before creating another identity or resending.
accountFees.notRecorded: No committed receipt is visible yet. The original request may still be in progress; this does not establish failure.
accountFees.recoverMeaning: Reuse the original identity, credential version, and pair. A successful receipt returns the original observation. Only if none exists will the currently controlled source be read. No new operation identity is created.
accountFees.otherPending: Fee synchronization for account #{{account}} needs confirmation. Open that account’s fee page to query the original result.
accountFees.unreadable: The stored synchronization identity cannot be read. New synchronizations are paused. Keep this browser session and investigate its storage state.

feeModel.meaning: Choose an existing observation. Market orders use its taker cost rate, frozen when a run is created. Current rates are not historical actual rates.
feeModel.chooseDataset: Choose an OKX or Binance spot dataset, then select an observation for the same exchange and symbol.
feeModel.receivedAssetPolicy: Settle in the received asset: base on BUY, quote on SELL. Positive fees charge; negative fees rebate. BNB discount payment is not available in this model.
feeModel.noTrades: No research trades for this run
feeModel.quoteFeeMeaning: Native fees are the model's payment or rebate quantities. Quote valuation is for reporting; base fees already affect net holdings and are not charged to cash again. Legacy records keep missing native facts missing.
feeModel.expired: This observation has expired and cannot create new configurations or runs. Previously frozen models keep their original rate.
feeModel.empty: No fee observations for this symbol. Check source availability on the account fees page; missing rates are not treated as zero.
feeModel.selectRequired: Select a complete fee observation matching the dataset symbol.
feeModel.invalidJson: Execution parameters must be a valid JSON object. Correct them under advanced parameters.
feeModel.frozenMeaning: Uses the original account observation and freeze time. Positive rates are costs; negative rates are rebates. This is a research/SIM model, not historical actual fees.
feeModel.directionalFrozenMeaning: Uses the original observation and freeze time: positive fees charge and negative fees rebate. Backtests and independent SIM consume the frozen buy/sell terms and payment currencies. This does not represent historical applicable rates or fees on actual executed trades.
feeModel.frozenUnavailable: The fee source snapshot is incomplete; the model cannot be confirmed.

discountFee.fallbackBuyRate: Buy rate when discount balance is insufficient
discountFee.fallbackSellRate: Sell rate when discount balance is insufficient
discountFee.actualPaymentMeaning: These directional rates apply to insufficient-balance fallback. Each decision uses native balances and frozen prices to select payment; only the recorded fill outcome represents actual use.
discountFee.receivedPolicy: Pay fees in the received asset
discountFee.fundedPolicy: Use BNB discounts when adequately funded
discountFee.policyMeaning: Declare a discount-asset budget and freeze the historical conversion source. Only standard commission is discounted; insufficient BNB falls back to the received-asset terms.
discountFee.conditionsUnavailable: This observation does not enable discounts for both the account and the symbol.
discountFee.fractionMeaning: Enter a ratio between 0 and 1 with up to 8 decimals. For example, 0.10 means 10% of the total budget.
discountFee.fractionInvalid: Use an exact string strictly between 0 and 1, with up to 8 decimals.
discountFee.datasetRequired: Select a formal one-minute BNB/USDT conversion dataset.
discountFee.datasetUnavailable: No same-exchange READY/OK one-minute BNB/USDT dataset is available. Supply the formal market data first.
discountFee.datasetNoLongerEligible: The selected dataset no longer meets the conversion requirements. Select another source.
discountFee.serverFieldsForbidden: The server seals conversion snapshots. Select the source again instead of submitting an existing snapshot identity.
discountFee.policyFieldsInvalid: This payment policy cannot retain discount budgets or conversion fields. Select the policy again.
discountFee.frozenMeaning: USDT and BNB are allocated within the total budget and consumed under the frozen fraction and conversion source. No exchange purchase or transfer is performed.
discountFee.priceUnavailable: The discount-asset conversion price is unavailable. Native balances remain visible; equity and PnL cannot currently be confirmed.
discountFee.chargeUnavailable: The original fee selection is incomplete. Payment currency and reserve cannot be confirmed.
discountFee.simInheritance: Enter only the total initial budget. The discount fraction, payment terms and conversion source are inherited from the published backtest. Allocation stays within the budget and adds no extra assets.

schedulerOperations.unreadable: The original scheduler operation record cannot be read. Keep this session and restore lookup before submitting another operation.
schedulerOperations.meaning: Look up the original operation first. New submissions remain paused until the result is confirmed; lookup does not run the job again.
schedulerOperations.notRecorded: The original receipt has not been found. This does not prove failure. Confirm the job and parameters before continuing under the same ID.
schedulerOperations.resumeMeaning: Reuse the original ID, job and parameters. The server returns the original result for completed requests without running them again.
schedulerOperations.status_STARTING: Request received; the job has not been claimed. Confirm before continuing the original request.
schedulerOperations.status_RUNNING: The original job has been claimed; its ending result is still unconfirmed. Keep querying without running again.
schedulerOperations.status_REJECTED: The original request failed its prerequisite checks; the job did not run.
schedulerOperations.status_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The original job has no complete ending fact. Keep the original ID for lookup and do not submit another run.
schedulerOperations.rejected: The request did not meet its prerequisites. Review this job capability and readiness.

shadowCreation.meaning: The original release and recovery reference are retained. Query the result first. Reloading or signing in again never starts another creation.
shadowCreation.missing: This query did not find a result. It does not prove that creation failed. Continue only by confirming the same release and reference.
shadowCreation.permission: Sign in as the original operator with operator or admin permission to query this result.
shadowCreation.resumeMeaning: Reuse the saved release and reference and run the formal admission check again. This does not start a different creation command. The original result may not yet be visible.
shadowCreation.confirmedMeaning: Original creation is confirmed. Current record status: {{status}}. Creation and this query do not grant startup or trading authority.
shadowCreation.queryOnly: Only the original record was queried. Creation was not replayed and no run was started.
shadowCreation.coordinationUnavailable: The browser cannot safely coordinate recovery references. Creation was not submitted. Use a modern browser supporting this feature.
shadowCreation.pendingMeaning: An original creation is still unconfirmed. Query its result first.
shadowCreation.scopeChanged: The signed-in identity changed. The command still belongs to its original operator. Sign in as that operator to query it.
shadowCreation.identityUnavailable: A safe recovery reference could not be generated. Creation was not submitted.
shadowCreation.lookupRequired: Query the original creation result before retrying an unconfirmed command.
shadowCreation.invalidResponse: The response does not match the original release and creation facts. The reference is retained. Query again.
shadowCreation.queryUnavailable: The original creation evidence cannot be verified yet. The reference is retained. Query again later.

continuousOperations.meaning: The original ID and inputs are retained. Check its result first; refreshing will not create or change a run again.
continuousOperations.missing: No original result was found. This does not prove it never executed. Keep its ID and confirm explicitly before continuing the same operation.
continuousOperations.confirmMeaning: Reuse the original ID, publication or run, and budget. If already completed, the server returns that original result without generating a new ID.
continuousOperations.storageUnavailable: The pending operation cannot be read or saved reliably. Related submissions are disabled. Restore browser storage access and refresh while keeping existing records.
continuousOperations.coordinationUnavailable: This browser cannot coordinate operations across pages. Try a browser that supports this capability; the original ID is retained.
continuousOperations.pendingMeaning: An operation is awaiting confirmation or another page is processing it. Check the original result first.
continuousOperations.permission: Your current permissions allow checking the original result, but not continuing the operation.
continuousOperations.scopeChanged: Your session or permissions changed. The original ID is retained; sign in again and check its result.
continuousOperations.identityUnavailable: This browser cannot generate a reliable operation ID. No request was sent.
continuousOperations.invalidInput: Check the original publication, run, and budget. The budget must be above zero, at most 100,000 USDT, with up to eight decimal places.
continuousOperations.invalidResponse: The result is incomplete or does not match the original operation. Its ID is retained; check again.
continuousOperations.lookupRequired: Check the original result before deciding to continue the same operation.
continuousOperations.executionOff: This environment does not provide further submissions. You can still check the original result.
continuousOperations.originalResult: This is the original operation result. The progress below comes from a fresh read of the current run.
continuousOperations.executionUnknown: Submission availability has not been confirmed. You can check the original result first.
continuousOperations.reading: Checking the original result. If another page is submitting, wait for it to finish.
continuousOperations.readTimeout: The original result check timed out. Its ID is retained; check again.

paperAlerts.scope: Alerts belong to this simulation run. Read means viewed; acknowledged means taken on; resolved means handled.
paperAlerts.permission: Only operators or administrators can create, acknowledge or resolve alerts. Existing alerts and your original operation results remain readable.
paperAlerts.meaning_CREATE: Create a low-severity manual test alert for this run. This does not trigger trading.
paperAlerts.meaning_ACK: Take responsibility for this alert. This does not resolve it or resume the run.
paperAlerts.meaning_RESOLVE: Mark this alert as handled. This does not resume the run or release risk controls.
paperAlerts.testMessage: Created manually from this run's alert panel.
paperAlerts.completed: Alert operation confirmed; reading current state
paperAlerts.sourceMeaning: This alert is expanded below, showing its current business state.
paperAlerts.recoveryMeaning: The original run, action, input and ID are saved. Reload only reads the original result. Confirming a historical result refreshes the current alert.
paperAlerts.missing: No original result was found yet. This does not prove it never executed. You can explicitly continue with the same ID and input.
paperAlerts.continueMeaning: Continue with the saved run, action, full input and original ID. The server still checks current state and permissions.
paperAlerts.originalConfirmed: Original result confirmed; reading current alert
paperAlerts.sessionChanged: Your login session changed. Read the original result again in the current session.
paperAlerts.storageUnavailable: The alert operation record cannot be read or saved safely. New operations are stopped. Restore browser storage access and retry; keep the pending record.
paperAlerts.pendingChanged: The pending record changed. Read the original operation again.
paperAlerts.pendingExists: An alert operation still needs confirmation. Read its original result first.
paperAlerts.responseInvalid: The original result identity or content could not be verified. The pending record is retained.
paperAlerts.coordinationUnavailable: This browser cannot safely coordinate operations across tabs. Use a browser that supports this capability.
paperAlerts.busy: Another tab is handling this alert operation. Read its original result shortly.
paperAlerts.lookupRequired: Read the original result in the current session before explicitly continuing.
paperAlerts.readTimeout: Reading the original result timed out. Its ID is retained; try reading again shortly.
paperAlerts.inputInvalid: Alert input is incomplete or exceeds the supported limits.

scheduleCreation.strategyHelp: Select a real strategy by name or code. A schedule inherits its account, exchange and environment. Disabled strategies can be configured; creating a schedule does not enable the strategy.
scheduleCreation.customCron: Custom Cron (six fields or a supported macro)
scheduleCreation.cronHelp: Six fields: second, minute, hour, day, month and weekday. Every five minutes: 0 */5 * * * *. The server validates the expression.
scheduleCreation.zoneHelp: Uses the browser time zone and freezes it on submission. Changing devices or zones does not change an existing schedule. A missing zone prevents submission.
scheduleCreation.dailyHelp: Hours, minutes and seconds are supported. A start after the end crosses midnight; equal times mean all day. These are daily times, not absolute dates.
scheduleCreation.daysHelp: Leave empty for every day. Weekdays follow the local date used by the window.
scheduleCreation.jsonHelp: Retains all existing window fields and exact numeric text, up to 8 KiB. No automatic reordering or floating point rewrite. The server validates times, weekdays and the window time zone.

scheduleCreation.enableHelp: Disabled by default. Enabling permits scheduler checks only. The strategy, admission conditions and scheduler driver must still allow execution; this does not mean a run has started.
scheduleCreation.invalidInput: Check the window: use a valid JSON object or complete daily times with seconds. Raw window text must not exceed 8 KiB.
scheduleCreation.unknownHelp: The original ID and full input have been retained. Query the original result first. Do not create a new ID or change the original input. You can return after closing the page.
scheduleCreation.missing: The original result is not currently visible. This does not prove that the request never ran. Only continue with the original ID and input after confirming.
scheduleCreation.resumeHelp: Resends the frozen original ID and complete input. The server returns the original result or creates once atomically; changed form values are not used.
scheduleCreation.snapshotMeaning: This is the original creation receipt. Open details to read the current state after later changes. The receipt remains unchanged.
scheduleCreation.readOnly: Your role can read schedules but cannot create or recover creation.
scheduleCreation.storageUnavailable: The original creation input cannot be safely read or saved. Creation has stopped. Restore browser storage or resolve the original record; do not clear an unknown request and create another.
scheduleCreation.coordinationUnavailable: This browser cannot coordinate creation across tabs. Use a browser with secure locks. No request was sent.
scheduleCreation.scopeChanged: The signed-in identity changed. The original request remains under its owner; sign in as that owner to query it.
scheduleCreation.identityUnavailable: A stable creation ID could not be generated. Check the browser secure context. No request was sent.

orderCancellation.checkedHelp: The original order has been checked. Clearing removes only this local tracking record and does not change the order or funds.

legacyMonitor.daily: Legacy reports retain history and alert summaries. Unverified equity, returns and order or fill totals stay unknown. Use canonical SIM for trusted funds and analysis.
legacyMonitor.risk: These are legacy basic-check records. Historical PASSED or healthy fields are not canonical risk decisions. Actual risk checks belong to the formal SIM order path.
legacyMonitor.stability: Legacy heartbeat and metadata records do not measure uptime or qualify 24-hour or 7-day stability. Historical status marks are retained; actual runtime evidence belongs to canonical SIM.
legacyMonitor.recovery: These actions only save legacy recovery notes and events; they do not execute failed steps or rebuild trading facts. Actual result confirmation and recovery use canonical SIM.

maintenanceOperations.unconfirmed: UNKNOWN · The original result is not confirmed.
maintenanceOperations.rejected: The request was rejected before execution.
maintenanceOperations.noRetry: This maintenance action can span accounts. Refreshing or failing to retrieve its receipt does not authorize another execution.

errors.MAINTENANCE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot save the original request. No new maintenance command will be sent.

errors.MAINTENANCE_RESPONSE_INVALID: The response does not confirm the original request. Keep its result UNKNOWN.

researchDataset.help: Self-Hosted only: OKX spot BTC/ETH · 1h · 1–30 complete UTC days (at most 720 bars). Dates are UTC; the end date is excluded. The current incomplete UTC day is excluded. Thirty days do not establish strategy effectiveness.
researchDataset.windowInvalid: Choose 1–30 complete UTC days; the end date must be no later than today at 00:00 UTC.
researchDataset.afterIngestion: Check dataset quality before freezing research input. Missing data is never fabricated.
researchDataset.createDataset: Create a dataset from this window and check quality
researchDataset.fromJob: Original ingestion window loaded; verify it before explicitly creating a dataset
researchDataset.jobUnavailable: A valid OKX BTC/ETH 1h complete UTC-day job could not be read. Check the job ID.
researchDataset.freezeHelp: Choose an existing strategy, then bind a formal strategy version and cost assumptions in the backtest configuration. The server freezes research input; subsequent ingestion does not alter frozen input. At run creation the server reads current rules for the selected BTC/ETH instrument. Current rules, fees and slippage are not historical facts.
researchDataset.frozenUnavailable: Frozen input identity is unavailable. Check the original snapshot.
researchDataset.rulesHelp: At run creation the server reads and freezes current rules for the selected OKX BTC/ETH 1h instrument. Current rules are not historical rules; fees, slippage and minimum notional remain explicit research assumptions.

channelExposurePrecision: Exposure supports at most 8 decimal places
channelBehavior: Long only, confirmed at 1h bar close; 20/10 is a research baseline. Channels exclude the current bar. Enter strictly above prior highs, exit strictly below prior lows; equality does not trigger. HOLD creates no trade, rebalancing or pyramiding. Initial desired state is FLAT. Execution uses a legal event after actual signal availability. Channel exit is not a hard stop; profitability and optimal parameters are unproven.
channelNext: Spot channel breakout: set entry/exit lookbacks and target allocation in the next step. 20/10 is a research baseline; HOLD creates no trade.

researchSim.title: Research → Publish → SIM Comparison
researchSim.readOnly: Read-only comparison: select an existing publication and SIM. This view does not publish, create or start runs.
researchSim.periods: Historical research and forward SIM cover different market periods. A return difference alone does not prove an implementation error. Unknown fees and missing prices remain UNAVAILABLE.
researchSim.selectionRequired: A successful Walk-Forward validation with a final frozen selection is required.
researchSim.validationExperimentMismatch: This validation does not belong to the current experiment. Select a validation from this experiment's history to continue.
researchSim.selectionMismatch: The candidate or version in the URL differs from this validation's final frozen selection. Comparison results are hidden.
researchSim.holdoutHidden: Final Holdout has not been explicitly viewed. Use this validation's “Record and view Final Holdout” button above. Refreshing the comparison will not record a view.
researchSim.eligibility: Selection does not grant publication eligibility. The server verifies version, checksum, parameters, an eligible full-window backtest and the publication/SIM relationship. Independent FLAT tests and holdout runs cannot bypass SIM admission.
researchSim.noPublish: No successful publication exists for this version. This view will not create one.
researchSim.sim: Existing SIM created from this publication
researchSim.noSim: No accessible SIM exists for this publication. This view will not create or start one.
researchSim.metricBases: Different market periods and metric bases do not support direct return attribution
researchSim.performance: Research and forward SIM performance facts
researchSim.cursor: View the existing Continuous SIM cursor
researchSim.decisions: Decision and execution differences in shared observation windows
researchSim.trustedWindow: The formal strategy is recomputed only from persisted input available at the time. Unproven shared observations are NOT_COMPARABLE. Historical backtest signals are never presented as future SIM signals.
researchSim.decisionWindow: Showing at most the latest {{limit}} persisted decisions, out of {{total}} in this run.
researchSim.windowLimited: This window does not cover all history
researchSim.noRecommendation: This view reports facts and differences. It does not infer strategy failure, future returns or LIVE eligibility, and does not stop strategies automatically.

walkForward.title: Walk-Forward & Robustness
walkForward.shortSample: Short sample: 30 days cannot establish long-term robustness or authorize automated LIVE trading
walkForward.exposure: The source experiment already used the full dataset. The final holdout is isolated from selection in this validation, but is not pristine. Reuse and explicit views are retained.
walkForward.reset: Each Test starts with independent capital and a FLAT position; warmup trading is disabled. Fold profits are not added into a portfolio return.
walkForward.selection: Fixed selection: after-cost training return descending, drawdown ascending, then stable ordinal ascending. Final selection retrains on [0,600), freezes, then evaluates [600,720).
walkForward.completedRequired: Select a fully successful experiment before submitting.
walkForward.frozenBeforeTest: Uses frozen selection for this fold
walkForward.results: Training, independent Test & cost stress results
walkForward.mean: Mean of three independent OOS returns (not a portfolio return)
walkForward.dependence: Largest single-window share of absolute returns
walkForward.ranks: Training ranks per fold (fold 4 is final retraining)
walkForward.returnDifference: Training return difference B minus A
walkForward.holdoutUsage: Dataset validation runs: {{uses}}; explicit views of this validation: {{views}}. The source experiment already used the full window.
walkForward.invalidIdentity: Invalid stored validation operation identity; preserve it for investigation.

selectedVersion.writeRequired: Research write permission is required to activate.
selectedVersion.confirm: Activate the same final selected version? Parameters and checksum will remain unchanged.
selectedVersion.publishLink: Open the original backtest publish workflow
selectedVersion.confirmed: The original selected version is confirmed ACTIVE. Publishing still requires a separate explicit action.
selectedVersion.recover: If the submission outcome is unknown, query the current version status. Refreshing, signing in and navigation never activate automatically.
